claim: The JsxSelfClosingElement case in getCompletionData was migrated from SlashToken to LessThanSlashToken, a token/parent combination that can never occur, making the branch dead code.
raw: **Verified against source:** the scanner only emits `LessThanSlashToken` for `<` immediately followed by `/` (scanner.ts:254/2209/3706), and the parser gives a self-closing element's trailing slash a plain `SlashToken` (parser.ts:6215)

claim: Brace matching regresses for JSX closing tags: the braceMatching map has no LessThanSlashToken entry and the fix removed the LessThanToken child, so the lookup returns emptyArray.
raw: **Impact:** "go to matching brace" on the `>`/`text`) in a `.tsx` file now does nothing — a regression versus pre-PR behavior, caused by the fix.

claim: The shared global scanner's language variant is set and reset with no try/finally, so any throw in between leaves the process-wide singleton in JSX mode and mis-tokenizes later .ts scans.
raw: `createChildren` mutates the process-wide singleton `scanner` (exported at utilities.ts:391, created as `Standard`) to the file's variant at line 509 and resets it to `Standard` at line 530 with **no `try/finally`**.

claim: The new languageVariant? on SourceFileLike lacks /** @internal */ (unlike its siblings), so it ships in the public API baseline and permanently widens TypeScript's public surface.
raw: both sibling optional members (`lineMap?`, `getPositionOfLineAndCharacter?`) carry `/** @internal */`; `languageVariant?` does not, so it ships in the published baseline (`tests/baselines/reference/api/typescript.d.ts:5910`), permanently widening TypeScript's public API

claim: Behavioral completion and isInsideJsxElement* changes ship with no PR-authored test; only the two syntactic-classification baselines were updated.
raw: The diff changes five completion trigger/location checks plus two `isInsideJsxElement*` branches, but adds/updates only the two *syntactic-classification* baselines.

claim: ?? LanguageVariant.Standard latently re-introduces the mis-tokenization bug for any SourceFileLike that omits the optional languageVariant field; two such literals exist in-repo.
raw: But `getChildren`/`getFirstToken`/`getLastToken` accept any `SourceFileLike`, and two in-repo literals build one **without** the field (`textChanges.ts:1339`, `sourcemaps.ts:231`). Neither is proven to reach `createChildren` today, so this is **latent**

claim: No comment documents createChildren's scanner language-variant assumption before or after the change — a pre-existing documentation gap.
raw: No comment documents the scanner's language-variant assumption either before or after the change, so there's nothing stale — just a (pre-existing) documentation gap, not an accuracy problem.

claim: The new languageVariant? field on SourceFileLike carries no doc comment — a completeness gap.
raw: The field itself has no doc comment, but that's a completeness gap rather than an inaccuracy, and it's consistent with the sibling `text` property which is also undocumented.

claim: Out-of-scope aside: the SlashToken to LessThanSlashToken rename at completions.ts:3511 appears to make that case unreachable for self-closing elements — a possible functional regression.
raw: This one line, by contrast, appears to make that `case` unreachable for self-closing elements — a possible functional regression, not a comment problem. No fourslash test in the diff exercises this branch.

claim: Wrong token kind substituted in the self-closing-tag completion-location case; LessThanSlashToken can never match when the JsxSelfClosingElement guard holds, so the case is dead code.
raw: The pre-PR code correctly used `SyntaxKind.SlashToken` here; this hunk in the diff changed it to `SyntaxKind.LessThanSlashToken`, which can structurally never match when the guard `JsxSelfClosingElement` is true. The `case` is now dead code

claim: braceMatching map not updated for LessThanSlashToken, so go-to-matching-brace on a .tsx closing tag now returns emptyArray — a regression versus pre-PR editor behavior.
raw: There is no longer a `LessThanToken` child of a `JsxClosingElement`, and the map has no entry keyed on `LessThanSlashToken`.

claim: The isInsideJsxElementOrAttribute / isInsideJsxElement LessThanSlashToken branches have no test coverage anywhere in the repo.
raw: **Severity 6 — `isInsideJsxElementOrAttribute`/`isInsideJsxElement` LessThanSlashToken branches untested.** No fourslash test positions the cursor exactly adjacent to `</` while calling `verify.isValidBraceCompletionAtPosition` or `verify.toggleLineComment`

claim: The getJsxClosingTagCompletion / isValidTrigger / getCompletionData paths have no PR-owned test — coverage is only incidental via untouched pre-existing tests.
raw: **Severity 4 — `getJsxClosingTagCompletion`/`isValidTrigger`/`getCompletionData` completions paths have no PR-owned test.** Functionally covered (see #2), but nothing in this diff documents or locks in that coverage

claim: JSX fragment closing tags (</>) are untested for this change; no classification test covers JSX fragments at all though parseJsxClosingFragment also consumes LessThanSlashToken.
raw: **Severity 3 — JSX fragment closing tags (`</>`) untested for this change.** `parseJsxClosingFragment` (`src/compiler/parser.ts:6353`) also consumes a `LessThanSlashToken`, so `createChildren` classifying a fragment's `</>` is subject to the identical fix

claim: No dedicated leak test proves a .tsx classification followed by a .ts classification in the same session doesn't leak JSX-mode scanning.
raw: **Severity 2 — scanner language-variant reset (`scanner.setLanguageVariant(LanguageVariant.Standard)` after use) has no dedicated leak test.**

claim: The LF-to-CRLF line-ending churn in the two fourslash test files is an unintentional editor artifact — a style nit.
raw: It has no effect on test semantics and isn't worth flagging beyond a style nit (not a coverage issue).

claim: Public API surface widened unintentionally: the new field has no @internal tag unlike its neighbor and consequently ships in the public typescript.d.ts baseline.
raw: **Public API surface widened unintentionally.** `src/compiler/types.ts:4291` has no `@internal` tag, unlike its immediate neighbor at `4289-4290`, and consequently ships in `tests/baselines/reference/api/typescript.d.ts:5910`.

claim: Interface Segregation violation: one consumer's need is pushed onto the shared SourceFileLike interface instead of an explicit languageVariant parameter as formatNodeGivenIndentation already does.
raw: **Interface Segregation violation.** One consumer function's need is pushed onto a 15+-consumer shared interface instead of using the codebase's own established alternative (explicit parameter, as in `formatNodeGivenIndentation`, `src/services/formatting/formatting.ts:437`)

claim: Silent-default footgun: optional field plus ?? Standard means any SourceFileLike literal that omits it degrades silently to Standard scanning; two such literals already exist (textChanges.ts:1339, sourcemaps.ts:231).
raw: **Silent-default footgun.** Optional + external default (`?? Standard`) means any current or future `SourceFileLike` literal that forgets the field degrades silently to `Standard`-variant scanning instead of failing loudly.

claim: Conceptual duplication: SourceFile.languageVariant (required, parser-populated) and SourceFileLike.languageVariant (optional, caller-populated) now name the same concept with different guarantees.
raw: **Conceptual duplication across the hierarchy.** `SourceFile.languageVariant` (required, parser-populated, trustworthy) and `SourceFileLike.languageVariant` (optional, caller-populated, unverified) now name the same concept with very different strength guarantees.

claim: The new member lacks a doc comment stating default-on-omission, and the interface's "used in multiple utility functions" comment is now inaccurate for it (used in exactly one).
raw: otherwise the "used in multiple utility functions" comment on `SourceFileLike` is now inaccurate for this member (it's used in exactly one).

claim: case LessThanSlashToken paired with the untouched JsxSelfClosingElement guard is an always-false condition, making location = currentToken dead code and silently dropping self-closing completion behavior.
raw: This one occurrence is the odd one out: it swaps the token kind but keeps the self-closing semantic check, so `currentToken.kind === SyntaxKind.LessThanSlashToken && currentToken.parent.kind === SyntaxKind.JsxSelfClosingElement` is now an always-false condition

claim: The setLanguageVariant(Standard) reset is not wrapped in try/finally, so an exception between lines 509 and 530 leaves the scanner in the JSX variant (robustness, not security).
raw: The reset at `services.ts:530` (`scanner.setLanguageVariant(LanguageVariant.Standard)`) is not wrapped in `try/finally`, so if an exception is thrown between lines 509 and 530 the scanner is left in the JSX variant.

claim: JSX variant leak on the shared global scanner — no try/finally around set/reset, so a throw leaves the singleton in JSX mode and mis-tokenizes .ts files in classifier/organizeImports/preProcess/completions.
raw: `createChildren` mutates the module-level singleton `scanner` (defined `src/services/utilities.ts:391`, created in `LanguageVariant.Standard`) to JSX at line 509 and only restores Standard at line 530. There is no `try/finally`.

claim: Self-closing element case rewritten to a token that never occurs there; the case is unsatisfiable and dead, regressing completion location fix-up for <Foo /**/ />.
raw: So `currentToken.kind === LessThanSlashToken && parent === JsxSelfClosingElement` is now unsatisfiable — the case is dead. The PR is internally inconsistent: `completions.ts:4834` and `:4843` correctly keep `SlashToken` for the self-closing/opening-element `/`.

claim: Five completion trigger/location token-kind checks changed but no fourslash completion test was added or changed — only two classification baselines.
raw: The diff changes five token-kind checks that drive JSX completion triggering/location (`completions.ts:1598,3511,3521,5808`) but adds/updates only two *syntactic-classification* baselines (`syntacticClassificationsJsx1/2.ts`). No fourslash completion test is added or changed

claim: ?? LanguageVariant.Standard silently re-introduces the original bug for any SourceFileLike lacking languageVariant; the optional field means the type system gives no signal.
raw: But `getChildren`/`getFirstToken`/`getLastToken` accept any `SourceFileLike`; a JSX file passed as a `SourceFileLike` that omits `languageVariant` silently falls back to Standard — the exact original mis-tokenization — with no error or signal.

claim: New languageVariant? lands in the shipped public API surface with no @internal tag and no doc comment, unlike its sibling members.
raw: Both sibling optional members added earlier to `SourceFileLike` (`lineMap?`, `getPositionOfLineAndCharacter?`) carry `/** @internal */`; the new `languageVariant?` does not, so it lands in the shipped public surface

claim: getPossibleTypeArgumentsInfo and the breakpoints switch have no LessThanSlashToken case, so a JSX closing bracket now falls through to their defaults; appears benign but untested.
raw: `getPossibleTypeArgumentsInfo` (`utilities.ts:2049`) and the breakpoint switch (`breakpoints.ts:323`) have no `LessThanSlashToken` case, so a JSX closing bracket that previously surfaced as `LessThanToken` now falls through to their defaults.

claim: New languageVariant? on SourceFileLike is not marked @internal unlike its sibling optional members, so it leaks into the published typescript.d.ts and permanently widens the public API contract.
raw: The other two optional members of this interface (`lineMap`, `getPositionOfLineAndCharacter`) both carry `/** @internal */`; only `readonly text` is public. The new property omits the tag, so it leaks into the published `typescript.d.ts`

claim: The shared module-level scanner singleton has its language variant mutated globally and reset only on the happy path, silently corrupting other consumers (completions.ts:1898, preProcess.ts:338) if scanning throws.
raw: `createChildren()` now sets the variant on entry and resets it (`setText(undefined)` + `setLanguageVariant(Standard)`) only after `node.forEachChild(...)` returns normally, with no `try/finally`.

claim: Dead case arm: a LessThanSlashToken can never have a JsxSelfClosingElement parent, so the Fix location branch is unreachable and location is no longer narrowed to the slash token.
raw: So `case SyntaxKind.LessThanSlashToken: if (currentToken.parent.kind === SyntaxKind.JsxSelfClosingElement)` is unreachable — a token of that kind never has that parent kind.

claim: The languageVariant fallback consults only the passed SourceFileLike, never the node's real source file, and textChanges.ts:1339 builds a SourceFileLike without the field though the correct value is in scope.
raw: `const languageVariant = sourceFile?.languageVariant ?? LanguageVariant.Standard;` (services.ts:507) defaults to `Standard` whenever the caller-supplied `SourceFileLike` doesn't set the (optional) `languageVariant` field — even if the node's real file is `.tsx`/`.jsx`.

claim: Resource cleanup gap: no try/finally around the shared scanner's text/variant mutation, so a Debug.fail during traversal leaves the singleton stuck at the JSX variant.
raw: `scanner.setLanguageVariant(languageVariant)` (line 509) and the reset `scanner.setLanguageVariant(LanguageVariant.Standard)` (line 530) bracket `node.forEachChild(processNode, processNodes)` (line 527) with no `try/finally`.
